attributes.title: Level 6

subgroups.name: solve 1

steps.hints: ❓Do the parameters in the checkLastAnswer function match the choices in showPlayerChoices?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How is the formatting of the choices in showPlayerChoices different from the formatting of the choices in the checkLastAnswer functions?


Solution: 

Choice parameters in if/else if conditional should be changed to “Easy” and “Hard”.
steps.instructions:
When the project runs, nothing happens after the user selects a choice from the menu! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that Ninja sprites are created based on the difficulty level selected by the user.

subgroups.name: solve 2

steps.hints: ❓ Which parameters in the spriteMoveToLocation function change the position that a sprite moves to?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Which parameters set the sprite’s new x and y-position?


Solution: 

Arguments passed to the x and y parameters in spriteMoveToLocation code on Line 94 should be changed to coordinates at center of screen (80, 60).
steps.instructions:
When the Player sprite overlaps the HiddenNinja sprite, the HiddenNinja sprite moves to the top left corner of the screen.


Fix the bugs in the code so that when the Player sprite overlaps the HiddenNinja sprite, the HiddenNinja moves to the center of the screen.

subgroups.name: solve 3

steps.hints: ❓Which parameters in the spritesSayText function will change the color of the text and the text box?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ What colors might be used as the foreground and background in the spriteSayText code?


Solution: 

2 different number arguments should be used in the foreground and background parameters of the spriteSayText code.
steps.instructions:
When the Player sprite overlaps the HiddenNinja sprite, the HiddenNinja sprite’s text is not visible!


Fix the bugs in the code so that when the HiddenNinja sprite says something, the text and the text box appear in 2 different colors.

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 6 of Purple Belt! Before you create your final Purple Belt project, there are a few neat tricks to learn that could take your game to the next level! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 6:

badges.title: Extension Explorer
badges.description: Use animation and music code, plus the scroller and story extensions, to enhance a project.

badges.title: Stop Motion
badges.description: Use an array of images to create an animation for a sprite.

badges.title: Path of Least Resistance
badges.description: Use an animation preset path to animate a sprite’s movement.

badges.title: Earworm
badges.description: Create a custom melody using a string of note names.

badges.title: Seven Layer Dip
badges.description: Use the Scroller extension to change the background image layers.

badges.title: Parallax Party
badges.description: Use the Scroller extension to move a background layer to create a parallax effect.

badges.title: The Choice is Yours
badges.description: Use the Story extension to present the player with choices.

badges.title: Stage Directions
badges.description: Use the Story extension to move a sprite to a specific position.

badges.title: What’s my Line?
badges.description: Use the Story extension to have a sprite say text with custom colors.
